title: We love it ! Perfect sit, good cushion, and fair price.
text: We love it ! Perfect sit, good cushion, and fair price.. Best product I bought when there were offers online! This seating gaming chair is the best I've ever had. I love how I can place it on the floor and just sit on it and it's super comfortable, it also helps with posture, well at least for me I like that it has the back part so you're not slouching or anything like that. I normally don't sit straight so this is good for my back. My husband loves it as well and he kind of has stolen it from me now, he's playing videogames in our living room again instead of his room XD

description: The Crew Furniture Classic Video Rocker Chair is a timeless favorite. It's perfect for playing video games, watching TV, reading, relaxing, or just hanging out with your crew. The modernistic, ergonomic style is built on a wood frame and padded with polyurethane foam. The faux leather vinyl and bold mesh racing stripe upholstery is attractive and easy to clean; just wipe with a damp cloth. It comes fully assembled, so you can start using it right away. With its compact size and light weight, you can move these chairs to anywhere your crew gathers, in your living room, bedroom, dorm room, or home theater.
